status: controller plan; source closure and exact commands must be frozen before fits
launch_precondition: all four clean reference parent/FT/export jobs successful; independent implementation grades pass; combined integration provenance frozen
screen_hard_rejections: any candidate blend or replacement pair class delta below-0.0005 versus reference
negative exact or softened-mask0.02/0.05 delta versus reference
nonfinite output/state, incomplete fixed epochs or unequal prescribed updates
leakage, unsupported fit membership or failed causal/stream parity
update_identity: Record successful/skipped optimizer updates, EMA updates, normalization identity, sample order and completed batches; unequal arm exposure invalidates a matched mechanism comparison.
confirmation_limitations: Previously inspected folds. Chain exclusions repair linked fitting rows, but do not create an untouched hidden-domain test.

spread_label.continuation_recipe: clean since parent recipe; lr0.001/wd0.01, fresh equal AdamW/OneCycle and EMA; struct0.3,next0.3,teacher1,evalEMA,fold propensity power2/eps0.03,true-mask0.03,since32/floor0.25
spread_label.evaluation_pair: 0.5 unchanged seed4 final FT + 0.5 arm seed3 final FT
spread_label.reference: equal clean seed3/seed4 final FT pair
spread_label.screen_gate: candidate pair minus reference >=0.0005 AND candidate pair minus matched control pair >0; no finite/parity/provenance failure
spread_label.durable_job_policy: One GPU job named final FT run wraps continuation,bothFTstages and fullVALIDexport;720seconds aggregate, not720seconds perstage.
spread_label.reason: Correct current-coordinate supervision could help or could remove useful legal future-tail supervision; identical masks control the intervention.

structured_state.recipe: clean since parent recipe with width96, two structured-state blocks; no FT on first screen
structured_state.evaluation_blend: 0.8 clean final FT reference pair + 0.2 arm
structured_state.screen_gate: multi blend minus reference >=0.0005 AND multi blend minus single blend >0; identical updates; slow-mode retention and long-gap diagnosis
structured_state.cap_amendment_policy: Equal cap may change based only on synthetic cost before either real fit; preserve original cap and amendment. Missing prescribed epochs invalidates comparison.
structured_state.claim_limit: Both arms learn all half-lives; comparison tests initialization and optimization, not disjoint hypothesis classes.

event_content.recipe: clean since parent recipe; first GRU96 plus four normalized memory heads; no FT on first screen
event_content.evaluation_blend: 0.8 clean final FT reference pair +0.2 arm
event_content.screen_gate: endpoint-content blend minus reference >=0.0005 AND positive versus both matched arm blends; identical updates and passing frozen TRAIN feature-exposure gates
event_content.cap_amendment_policy: Equal cap may change based only on synthetic cost before any real fit; preserve original cap and amendment. Missing prescribed epochs invalidates comparison.
claim_limits: Endpoint versus raw code changes write and decay jointly
No artificial origin writes in event heads
Endpoint extraction precedes normalization and AMP

promotion: Freeze mechanism, checkpoint epochs, pair weights and transforms before confirmation. Positive each confirmation fold, pooled gain greater than one chain-bootstrap SD,95percent interval reported, no class delta below-0.0005, exact/soft direction consistent. Do not sum correlated family gains.
expectation: Independent selection-corrected public forecast with predictive uncertainty and LOSO calibration must have mean>=0.6660; local gains alone do not pass.
